decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The window hereby permitted shall match the existing windows to the property.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 4 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the side walls of the extension without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - The window hereby approved shall be obscured glazed and consist of a lower fixed pane and an upper pane which shall be hinged to open inwards or outwards.  The windows shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than with obscure glazing.
description: Installation of window to side wall of extension
